name: Ownership and theft facts
notes: mw-e27.9: thefts are recorded as entity-scoped facts on a synthetic entity theft-<n> in the level they happened in, plus a global counter. Saves carry them.

facts.description: How many thefts have ever been recorded (mw-e27.9); the next theft is entity theft-<n>. Never reset.
The faction or NPC id the goods were stolen from (mw-e27.9); set on the theft entity entity:<level>/theft-<n>.
The item definition id that was stolen.
Units of the item still unreturned; a partial return lowers it.
The spawn id of the owned thing (container or world item) it was taken from.
The sim tick of the theft.
Whether anyone saw it: unknown until witness resolution (the AI, e10/e11) says seen or unseen.
stolen until the goods are returned into the owner's container, then returned.
